scope.mode: final plan-only closure audit after round-4 repairs

scope.severity_rule: Critical/high is reserved for a direct unmet user requirement, contradiction, unsafe or undefined implementation path, or material evidence overclaim. No implementation proof or passed future gate was required.

repair_reproduction.basis: Re-traced R-01 through R-16 to exact PLAN contracts, roadmap increments, validation, and human gates. PLAN sections 2 and 10.1 cover install, ideation/research, answer/status/why, READY, typed decisions, change requests, pause/resume/cancel, exceptions, review, merge policy, UNKNOWN disposition, feedback, upgrade/rollback, export, and uninstall with durable outcomes and replay/wait behavior.

PLAN sections 5, 5.1, 10, and 13 separate human DelegatedAdmissionPolicy issuance, the purpose-only policy_admission_receipt_issuer, runtime validation/consumption, and actuator authority. Delegation is closed to R0/R1, requires every human-needed predicate false, uses quota CAS and one-time binding, and falls back to an exact human wait on uncertainty or changed inputs.

PLAN section 10.1 and manifest section 16 define the same seven closed decision subjects and accept/request-changes/deny actions, with explicit expiry, withdrawal, stale handling, wait closure, status, and recovery. PLAN sections 7, 10, and 10.2 keep exceptions finite and define a non-waivable break-glass lifecycle.

PLAN sections 11 and 15 define Git-backed desired Issues/Projects configuration, optimistic reconciliation, operation-specific effects and UNKNOWN handling, exact-head review, restricted auto-merge promotion, outcome observation, and receipt-based cleanup. The normative manifest keeps cleanup entry and terminalization in separate transactions.

PLAN sections 5, 5.1, 12, 13, 16, and 17 consistently require tenant plus typed ScopeRef, authenticated identity derivation, capability intersection, dual-owner cross-boundary transfer for all five dependency types, least-privilege roles, consumer integrity, and second-repository isolation gates.

Direct inspection reproduced the repaired dedicated receipt issuer, total cross-boundary dependency dispatch, owner decision matrix, wait cancellation coverage, canonical factory entry/projection repairs, split cleanup, child-outcome synchronization, improvement reducer/widening/completeness contracts, compensation-origin separation, whole-work cancellation, and exact quiescence predicate. This conclusion does not rely on the resolution register alone.

The evidence artifacts consistently label legacy retrieval provenance and semantic entailment unverified, describe structural validation narrowly, and keep immutable re-fetch plus human semantic review as a future pre-implementation blocker. material-claims.json is bound to the current PLAN and normative-manifest SHA-256 digests and does not claim that future gate passed.

residual_uncertainty: This is a plan-only closure result. It does not prove implementation, model checking, operational safety, source truth, semantic entailment, or local product outcomes.
The fresh immutable evidence run and human semantic review remain future blocking gates and were not treated as passed.
